page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at left. Single text column, right of centre, with a wide empty column to its left (no notes). Catchword-like line "Christi-" is a hyphenated line-end at the foot of the column, separated by a rule.

main_text.p: simplicem populum illicien-dum, falsæ reliquiæ suppone-bantur, & ficta prædicabantur miracula, ijsque miraculis populi superstitio alebatur, vt magis in admiratione miraculorum raperetur, quàm ad sanctorum imitationem provocaretur; Nonnunquam autem æstu, & illusione dæmonis, hominum superstitione abutentis, per insomnia & visa, nouæ reliquiæ revelabantur, & eiusdem operatione, miracula edi videbantur. Hæc ille, verè Germanus-ne an Israelita? At nos edocti melius, liberè de nobis fidenterque prædicare audemus, quod

page.notes: Printed text is in one column; the left-hand column is empty. The word "Christi-" at the foot is a line-end hyphenated word that continues on the next page, so it is kept as a paragraph rather than a catchword. Some letters in the scan are faint (for example "Germanus-ne", "edocti") but read clearly enough.
